EventEmitter as a Domain Event Bus

Node's built-in EventEmitter, and the one shared instance every service emits onto and every listener subscribes from.

  • What Is an EventEmitter?

    A built-in Node object that lets any number of listeners subscribe to a named event, with no import beyond node:events.

  • A Shared Emitter and Event Registry

    events/emitter.js: one EventEmitter every service and listener imports, plus a single source of truth for event-name strings.
